summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 2, 2026, announcing that two academic microbiology laboratories—City St George's University of London (Prof. Tim Bull) and Queen's University Belfast (Prof. Irene Grant, Dr. Hannah Dane)—confirmed in vitro that RHB-204 kills Mycobacterium avium subspecies paratuberculosis and performs comparably to RHB-104 in long-term intracellular culture and spot/phage assays. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory mechanics are disclosed; this is a clinical/science update for a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation event to trade around.
